tagline: The cafeteria has rules. The snacks don't.

    StartersWednesday pink wrapsRoast chicken, rocket and feta rolled with pink beetroot chickpea spreadHow to make it1 beetroot1 tin chickpeas2 tbsp tahini1 lemon1 garlic clove4 flour tortillas300g roast chicken, shredded60g rocket100g fetaWrap the beetroot in foil and roast at 200°C until tender, then peel.Blitz with the drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic until pink and smooth.Spread on the tortillas and fill with chicken, rocket and crumbled feta.Roll tight and slice into spirals.All-carb diet potato gemsCrisp potato gems under melted cheddar and spring onions, with sour creamHow to make it1kg frozen potato gems150g cheddar, grated3 spring onions, sliced150g sour cream1 tsp smoked paprikaHeat the oven to 220°C and spread the potato gems on two lined trays.Bake 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp.Pile into one tray, scatter with cheddar and paprika and bake 5 minutes more until melted.Top with spring onions and serve with sour cream.MainsHalloween party tacosSpiced beef mince in hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour creamHow to make it600g beef mince1 brown onion1 garlic clove1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika1 tbsp tomato paste150ml beef stock12 taco shells100g cheddar1/4 iceberg lettuce2 tomatoes150g sour creamBrown the mince hard with the diced onion and garlic.Stir in cumin, paprika and tomato paste, then loosen with stock and simmer.Warm the taco shells and prepare grated cheddar, lettuce and tomato.Spoon into shells with toppings and sour cream.Cafeteria crumbed chicken tendersCrisp tenders. You can't sit with usHow to make itAs written, serves 4Parmesan and panko crumbed chicken tenders baked crisp, with buttery mash and a crunchy cos salad, ranch dip on the side, served on trays.Cut 700g chicken breast into strips.Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 150g panko mixed with 40g parmesan and paprika.Bake on an oiled tray at 220°C for 18 minutes, turning once.Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk.Toss a chopped cos lettuce with cucumber and lemon dressing.Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, dill and chives for ranch.SweetsPink frosted cupcakesVanilla cupcakes with raspberry pink buttercreamHow to make it275g butter150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour125ml full cream milk300g icing sugar50g frozen raspberries1 jar pink sprinklesBeat part of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.Bake 12 at 175°C until springy.Cool completely.Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and strained raspberry puree until pale pink.Pipe on top and add sprinkles.Candy cane gram peppermint barkChocolate peppermint bark with candy canes. Four for you, Glen CocoHow to make it200g dark chocolate200g white chocolate1/2 tsp peppermint essence12 candy canes1 roll ribbonLine a tray with baking paper. Melt the dark chocolate, spread thin and chill until set.Melt the white chocolate with peppermint essence and spread over the top.Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes and press in lightly.Chill, then snap into shards.Tie the remaining candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon.DrinksPlastics raspberry pink lemonadeFresh lemon and raspberry lemonade topped with soda waterHow to make it150g caster sugar150ml hot water5 lemons150g raspberries1 L soda water1 bag iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Blend with the lemon juice and most of the raspberries, then strain.Pour into a jug with plenty of ice and top with soda water.Add lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries and pour into four glasses.
